audit: R0-D Final VLABench 7D Multi-Stage Feasibility Audit
hard_blockers: The released dataset has no skill, stage, transition, predicate, or boundary field.
All three data-backed four-stage candidates are low-dependency, order-insensitive classification placements.
The semantically strong heat_food and take_chemistry_experiment tasks have no released composite demonstrations.
Several official LeRobot surface names do not match upstream registrations, and exact replay lacks initial state/configuration.

recommendation.label: mixed benchmark design
recommendation.plan: Keep LIBERO for the stable 7D MaIL training/regression baseline and use the already-audited RoboCasa WashFruitColander subset as the multi-stage evaluation/pilot component.
